mobbin:23ce165d-078b-4adc-935a-83c4a40cb.summary: A traveler opens a trip overview, enters Get ready to fly, then scrolls a Ready to Fly set of time-limited prep tasks and know-before-you-go items.
steps: Trip overview with route and empty gate or seat
Panel inviting Get ready to fly
Ready to Fly with countdown and check-in cards
Ready to Fly with TSA, Wi-Fi and REAL ID cards
steal: A single Ready to Fly place keyed to one event or trip (screens 3 to 4) keeps pre-session readiness in one place.
Cards show time remaining or not-yet-available wording (screen 3), so you see what cannot be done yet versus what to do now.
Missing-data placeholders (--) on the trip card (screen 1) make incomplete setup fields easy to spot.
An entry panel from the trip (screen 2) nudges into the checklist without hunting menus.
avoid: Informational cards without tick, flag or broken statuses (screens 3 to 4) leave sim-tech equipment check without clear pass or fail.
mobbin:23ce165d-078b-4adc-935a-83c4a40cb.fit: Mobile and iPad app: a mobile readiness place fits walking the floor before a session better than desktop. Extend baseline equipment check and checklist with time-limited tasks, but add real tick and flag handoff that American Airlines lacks.
